holy_strike.name: Holy Strike
holy_strike.description: A blessed blow dealing ATQ + DEF magic damage, ignoring armor.

iron_wall.name: Iron Wall
iron_wall.description: Raise DEF by 3 (+1 per level) for 2 rounds.

backstab.name: Backstab
backstab.description: A vicious strike dealing double ATQ magic damage.

smoke_bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
smoke_bomb.description: Raise SPD by 2 (+1 per level) for 3 rounds to strike first.

venom_blade.name: Venom Blade
venom_blade.description: Poison the enemy for 3 (+1 per level) damage per round over 3 rounds.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: Hurl fire dealing ATQ + 4 magic damage, ignoring armor.

frost_armor.name: Frost Armor
frost_armor.description: Raise DEF by 2 (+1 per level) for 3 rounds.

arcane_surge.name: Arcane Surge
arcane_surge.description: Raise ATQ by 3 (+1 per level) for 2 rounds.

arrow_volley.name: Arrow Volley
arrow_volley.description: Loose a volley dealing ATQ + 2 magic damage, ignoring armor.

dodge_roll.name: Dodge Roll
dodge_roll.description: Raise SPD by 3 (+1 per level) for 2 rounds to strike first and evade.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.description: A savage swing dealing double ATQ magic damage.

blood_rage.name: Blood Rage
blood_rage.description: Raise ATQ by 4 (+1 per level) for 2 rounds.
